about_the_game:
Returns Outlet Simulator is a relaxed first-person simulation where every aspect of operating your own shop springs to life.

SUPPLY RETURNS PALLETS

Use the in-game computer to order returns pallets. Unpack them, arrange them in your storage area, and stock them on shelves.

STORE MANAGEMENT

Craft your store layout, balancing functionality and visual appeal. Decide product placement, organize your aisles, and guarantee a seamless shopping journey for your patrons.

BE A CASHIER

Scan products, process cash transactions, and make sure customers are happy with their shopping and payment experience.

GROW

With growing profits, think about reinvesting. Increase your store's size, enhance the interior design, and consistently adjust to the changing needs of the retail industry.

CUSTOMIZE

Make your store one-of-a-kind with personal touches. Adjust the flooring, paint the walls and more.

In "Returns Outlet Simulator" every choice you make has an impact. Can you step up, turning a small shop into a retail giant while juggling customer happiness and financial stability?
